skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Use a least common denominator or other common denominator to rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Operate with mixed and whole parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions by their whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result appropriately.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fraction units when the minuend fractional part is too small to subtract from directly.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce a non-lowest-terms fractional result or collapse a zero fractional component to give a simplified final answer.

skills.name: Find and use common denominators
skills.definition: Determine a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including zero or negative intermediate results.

skills.name: Separate and subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions in aligned whole-part and fractional-part form, including zero missing parts, and subtract or carry whole-number parts.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractional units when the fractional subtraction is negative.

skills.name: Simplify and normalize final form
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and normalize the final answer by omitting zero whole or fractional parts or writing an all-zero result as 0.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Separate, align, subtract, regroup, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts in mixed-number or whole-number subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Put the result in acceptable final form by reducing fractions to lowest terms or recognizing a zero fractional part as an integer or 0.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike fractional parts and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Use mixed-number structure
skills.definition: Separate whole-number and fractional parts, align missing parts as zero when needed, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and normalize final answers by omitting zero whole or fractional parts when appropriate.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional numerators when the fractions have a common denominator, including after conversion or regrouping, while keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Separate mixed or whole-number parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions by aligned whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Put the final answer in standard lowest-term form by reducing fractions and omitting zero whole or zero fractional parts.
